description: Violates §4.2 / required field: the manifest is missing the contractVersion field entirely. A manifest that declares an unsupported or missing contract version makes the artifact invalid; the runtime rejects it before any lifecycle operation (artifact-manifest.md §4.2). The contract version (ADR-024 §3.1) is semver, decoupled from runtime releases; major version is the compatibility unit. Without contractVersion, the runtime cannot determine which contract the manifest conforms to, and the artifact cannot enter any lifecycle stage.
